definitions.yoga: Combination of planets giving outsized results (e.g. Gajakesari, Budhaditya, Pancha Mahapurusha, Dharma-Karmadhipati, Dhana yogas).
definitions.core_principle: Dasa/bhukti is the control system (like control rods in a reactor) - not transits. A yoga gives results only in the dasa of a planet that carries it; an avayoga (bad yoga) likewise harms only in its dasa. Presence of a yoga is not proof of outcome.
definitions.self_reading_caution: Reading one's own chart tends to swing to extremes; balance is hard.

rules.name: Dhana yoga - 2-11 exchange
rules.result: Major wealth yoga - but only if their dasas run in a usable age.

rules.name: Rahu with own/exalted planet
rules.condition: Rahu (or Ketu) conjoined with a planet in own sign or exaltation
rules.result: Not a dosha - node boosts or takes over that planet's results. Especially strong for Venus-Rahu in Rishabam, Thulam or Meenam; also strong elsewhere if their dispositor is own/exalted.
rules.note: Rahu-Venus generally gives affluence and social standing.

rules.name: Wealth lords mutually placed
rules.condition: lord_2 and lord_11 in mutual kendra (not hidden 6/8/12 from each other); lord_11 own sign even if in 6th

rules.name: Exalted 10th lord
rules.result: Big career yoga; own business if not retrograde.
rules.modifier: If retrograde: employment, possibly top management, not own business. With Sun / lord_12 conjoined: high work pressure.

rules.name: Dasa lord in star of 6/8 planet
rules.condition: dasa lord sits in the nakshatra of lord_11 (or another giver) BUT that star lord is 6/8 from the dasa lord, and dasa lord is retrograde
rules.result: Expected gains don't materialise; limited income; pushes to employment.

rules.name: Retrograde own-sign 6th lord dasa in youth
rules.condition: own-sign planet (e.g. Saturn) in 6th, retrograde, running dasa during study years
rules.result: Obstacles in education (may manage only one degree despite multi-degree promise); health unaffected.

rules.name: Ketu dasa via strong deciding authorities
rules.condition: Ketu (even in 8th) whose sign lord and star lord are strong (e.g. both conjoined, one own sign, with Rahu boost)
rules.result: Ketu dasa brings sudden large wealth and lasting gains - this is NOT viparita raja yoga (which gives then takes away).

rules.name: Late activation
rules.condition: All wealth/career yogas present but their dasas fall late
rules.result: Ordinary life until those dasas arrive; report the activation age. A yoga dasa that already passed in infancy gives nothing usable.

rules.name: Avayoga that never fires
examples: Mars+Venus in 7th (classic poor-character indicator) can leave a native faithful or even unmarried if the dasa never activates it
Debilitated Mars can still give high police/authority positions
Rahu/Ketu in 3rd does not mean breast disease - check 3rd lord, Jupiter aspect, trine lords, star lords
rules.result: Avayogas also need dasa activation and lack of neutralisers to manifest.

engine_output_suggestion.yoga_report: For each detected yoga, list: yoga name, carrying planet(s), the dasas in which it activates, and age range - not just 'yoga present'.
engine_output_suggestion.avayoga_report: Same for doshas; mark as 'dormant' if their dasa is outside the relevant life window.

open_questions_for_implementation: Catalogue of named yogas (Gajakesari, Budhaditya, Pancha Mahapurusha, Dharma-Karmadhipati etc.) with detection logic
Viparita raja yoga detection to contrast with RY-07
